biggest_catch: This is a listing of many different studies with different eligibility rules - each study has its own screening, so finding one you qualify for can take effort.
catches: Each listed study has its own eligibility requirements - must qualify per study
Most studies are in-person at 6 Washington Place, NYC - local to New York
Exact pay is per study ($10-20/hr range); some specific listings pay flat amounts or bonuses
Listings include external institutions (Mount Sinai, Teachers College) - not all are NYU
Study availability changes; the page is a live listing that rotates

c1.evidence: as.nyu.edu NYU Psychology 'Paid Studies' page fetched 2026-09-23 (official NYU Arts & Science domain); pay range quoted verbatim

c2.evidence: Official department page states: 'Payment generally ranges from $10/hr to $20/hr'

c3.evidence: Steps from official page: browse currently available studies, sign up via the NYU Paid Psychology Research Sign-Up System

c4.evidence: Free to participate; no fee; IRB-approved non-invasive studies (computer tasks, questionnaires)

eligibility: All paid studies require participants to be at least 18; each study has its own specific eligibility requirements
notes: Standing paid-study program of NYU's Department of Psychology (distinct from R3047 NYU Stern behavioral lab and R3048 NYU CESS - different department, different pool). The page maintains a live listing of internal (Psych, Langone, Steinhardt) and external studies with per-study compensation. Payout numbers use the program-level stated range ($10-$20/hr); individual listings confirm it ($20 for 1 hour; $20/hr EEG 2-2.5 hrs; $25/hr OCD study). Time numbers use the stated typical visit range (30 min-2 hrs); some listings run longer or multi-visit.
numeric_basis: payout from official program terms ($10/hr-$20/hr); time: official stated typical per-study visit range (30 minutes to 2 hours)
payout_value_note: Stated program-level hourly range; individual listings vary (e.g. $20/hr EEG study, $25/hr OCD study, flat-fee studies).

steps: Browse the paid studies page for studies currently available
Check the specific requirements of a study that interests you
Sign up via the NYU Paid Psychology Research Sign-Up System
Complete the study (typically a single in-person visit at 6 Washington Place)
Receive payment at the study's stated rate ($10-$20/hr typical)
timing: Paid per completed study; disbursement method and timing not stated on the page.
